audience: teams that create contracts, offers and reports from Word or Excel templates in Plumsail

useCases.title: Check the account and its processes
useCases.text: Read the account profile, the document processes, and the fields that each process template uses.

useCases.title: Generate a document from a template
useCases.text: Fill a Word or Excel template with your data and get a link to the result file. Each call counts as one document.

useCases.title: Convert an Office file to PDF
useCases.text: Convert a Word, Excel or PowerPoint file to PDF and get a link to the PDF. Each call counts as one document.
